batch: Architecture Batch 2 - Surface-Owned Neural Transport boundary fidelity (attribution first; at most one candidate)
written: 2026-10-15, before any Batch-2 diagnostic was computed; worklog-32/33 results known
preserved: worklog-32 arms A/P1/P4/P16/P16w/REINIT (code experiments/rna_surface_ownership/, state.pt files), worklogs 21-33, upstream RNA 66b5b098; new code only in experiments/rna_surface_ownership_b2/

reference_protocol.primary_config: C2 (rough Ni alpha 0.3, worklog-32 data); C1 is a stress test only
reference_protocol.dev_views: C2 val views 0/10/20/30 with the worklog-33 8x-spp references (results/rna_baseline_quality/reference) - all diagnostics and any candidate design decisions use only these
reference_protocol.held_out_views: the other 36 C2 val views, each re-rendered at 8x spp (1024) with seed 950000+view by b2_reference.py (unchanged rna_bridge.render_view) - selected as 'all remaining views', independent of any candidate; used only for the final candidate-vs-control comparison
reference_protocol.reference_noise: reported from the worklog-33 replicate (dataset GT vs 8x ref, 29.4 dB pooled on dev views); an 8x reference has 1/8 of the dataset GT variance (~38.4 dB equivalent)
reference_protocol.secondary: all 40 val views against the stored dataset GT (worklog-32 contract), labelled noisy
reference_protocol.historical_gate: the worklog-32 25 dB gate is historical and is not applied or changed

diagnostics.pairs: 4-neighbour pixel pairs (right, down) on dev views; both alpha >= 0.999 (no silhouette/partial coverage); classes by P16 owner and part: seam (same part, different P16 unit), interior (same P16 unit), cross_part, plus a geometric-continuity test applied to seam and interior pairs: 3D hit distance <= 3 x the view's median interior-pair distance AND normal dot >= cos(20 deg); seam/interior pairs failing it are reclassified geometric_edge; pairs whose two pixels have different visibility labels are reported separately (shadow boundaries are physical radiance edges)
diagnostics.matched_comparison: interior pairs are reweighted to the seam pairs' distribution of reference radiance variation |d ref| (10 quantile bins of the seam pairs' |d ref| in RNA-tonemap space), so seam vs interior compares like physical variation
diagnostics.metrics_per_arm: A, P4, P16, P16w on C2 (and C1 stress): jump excess J = | |d pred| - |d ref| | (RNA tonemap, channel mean); signed error correlation rho(e_p, e_q); mean |e| at seam vs matched interior pixels
diagnostics.distance_profile: for every clean (alpha>=0.999) masked pixel: 3D distance to the nearest dense partition sample (partition_P16.npz x) of a DIFFERENT unit of the SAME part, in units of the view's median interior-pair distance (pixel footprint f); bins [0,1),[1,2),[2,4),[4,8),[8,16),[16,32),[32,inf); mean |e| per arm and P16/A, P16w/A ratio per bin
diagnostics.cross_evaluation: at seam pairs (p owned by i, q owned by j): evaluate unit j at p and unit i at q with the unchanged unit modules (local frame clamped as in OwnedTriplaneSet); report |f_i(p) - f_j(p)|, own error |f_i(p) - ref(p)|, neighbour error |f_j(p) - ref(p)|, and whether p lies inside unit j's AABB
diagnostics.posthoc_composition: learned parameters held fixed: partition-of-unity blend of the two nearest same-part units within a band of half-width 2f around the seam (weight linear in signed distance difference to the two units' nearest dense samples), all other pixels unchanged; measures how much of the seam excess a composition change alone removes and at what error cost; band width is derived from the pixel footprint, not tuned
diagnostics.training_support: from the C1 worklog-22 train H5 (C2 used the same cameras, light directions and seeds; only radiance differs): per P16 unit: sample count (= the decoder's whole training set), samples per unit area, samples within 2f of a same-part seam, light- and view-direction coverage (fraction of 128 equal-area upper-hemisphere bins hit, world frame)

hypothesis_rules.H1_support: SUPPORTED if (a) per-unit P16/A error ratio (C2 dev, vs ref) has Spearman rho <= -0.5 with the unit's training sample count, OR (b) the P16/A ratio in distance bins [0,2) is >= 1.10 x its value in bins >= 16; CONTRADICTED if neither holds and P16w (same per-unit samples, 16x capacity) leaves the ratio unchanged; else UNRESOLVED
hypothesis_rules.H2_independent_functions: SUPPORTED if P16's seam-pair error correlation is >= 0.2 lower than its matched-interior correlation while A's drop is < 0.05, AND the median cross-evaluation disagreement |f_i(p)-f_j(p)| at seam pixels is >= the median own error there; CONTRADICTED if the correlation drop is < 0.05; else UNRESOLVED
hypothesis_rules.H3_composition: SUPPORTED as a removable mechanism if the fixed-parameter post-hoc blend brings P16's seam jump excess to within 10% of A's matched value while seam-band pixel error does not increase by more than 2%; CONTRADICTED if the blend leaves >= 50% of P16's excess over A; else UNRESOLVED
hypothesis_rules.H4_other: local frame normalisation is tested by P1 vs A (worklog 32: equal); routing determinism by the existing tests; any other measured mechanism is reported as found

candidate_rule.mapping: H1 supported and dominant -> support-extended unit training (each unit trains on its owned samples plus same-part samples within a geometry-derived band beyond its boundary; rendering unchanged hard selection; parameter AND output ownership unchanged). H2 supported and H3 not -> immutable shared decoder (decoder trained once, frozen forever; each unit owns its triplane features). H3 supported -> explicit overlap composition contract (output influence widens to the band; must be accounted). If no hypothesis is SUPPORTED, or two are with no dominance, stop without a candidate.
candidate_rule.dominance: the hypothesis whose mechanism accounts for the larger share of P16's seam jump excess over A on dev views (H3: share removed by the post-hoc blend; H1: share located within distance bins [0,2) attributable to elevated own error; H2: share of seam pairs where cross-evaluation disagreement exceeds the jump threshold)
candidate_rule.training_contract: if a candidate needs training: C2 data, upstream loss/optimiser/schedule, 250 epochs, seed 0, P16 partition and matched capacity unchanged unless the hypothesis itself requires otherwise (declared before training); final weights
candidate_rule.evaluation: held-out 36 views vs 8x references: pooled PSNR (RNA tonemap), logL1, hf (top-10% GT-gradient) error, per part and per unit, seam jump excess and seam/interior error on clean pairs, plus all-40-view metrics vs dataset GT; controls A, P16, P16w unchanged
candidate_rule.reinit_regression: u* = the P16 tea-pot unit with the most training pixels (unit 12, worklog-32 rule); re-initialise/reconstruct its complete owned state; report parameter groups changed/unchanged, pixels whose output can change, and recovered quality

amendments.written: 2026-10-15 ~14:50 KST, after the dev-view diagnostics (results/rna_surface_ownership_b2/diag) and BEFORE any held-out view was evaluated or any candidate code existed

diagnostic_verdicts_C2.H1: SUPPORTED (weak) by rule (b) only: P16/A error ratio near seams [0,2) footprints 1.149 vs >=16 footprints 1.029 (x1.116 >= 1.10); rule (a) fails (Spearman count vs ratio +0.20); C1 stress 1.077 (not met); P16w 1.069
diagnostic_verdicts_C2.H2: SUPPORTED: P16 seam-pair error correlation 0.238 vs matched interior 0.710 (drop 0.47), A 0.641 vs 0.649 (drop 0.008); cross-evaluation median disagreement 0.0251 >= median own error 0.0210 (neighbour error 0.0242, 98.6% of band points inside the neighbour AABB)
diagnostic_verdicts_C2.H3: SUPPORTED: fixed-parameter blend (half-width 2 footprints) brings P16 seam J 0.0268 -> 0.0144 vs A 0.0137 (1.05x) while band error falls 0.0311 -> 0.0293

amendments.dominance: H3 removes 95% of P16's seam J excess over A. The protocol's H2 'jump threshold' was not specified in advance; operationalised here (declared now, before held-out evaluation) by the Gaussian decomposition E|e_p - e_q| ~ sigma*sqrt(2(1-rho)): seam/interior J ratio for P16 = magnitude factor 1.078 (H1-type) x decorrelation factor 1.621 (H2-type), i.e. ~13% / ~87% of the log ratio. H2 is the dominant MECHANISM, H3 the dominant removable LEVER; they are complementary (independent errors exposed by hard selection), not competing. Mapping rule 'H3 supported -> explicit overlap composition contract' applies.

candidate.name: P16-PU (partition-of-unity boundary composition over unchanged P16 units)
candidate.hypothesis: the visible within-object seams of independently owned units are hard-selection exposure of decorrelated per-unit errors; an explicit, geometry-defined composition across ownership boundaries removes the excess discontinuity without changing any learned parameter and without degrading physical accuracy
candidate.changes: composition only: output(x) = (1-w(x)) f_owner(x)(x) + w(x) f_nbr(x)(x), nbr = nearest other unit of the same part (dense partition samples), w = clip(0.5 - (d_nbr - d_own)/(2h), 0, 0.5); outside the band output = f_owner exactly
candidate.h: 0.0072 m = 2 x median dev-view pixel footprint (0.0036 m), derived from the diagnostic band, fixed now, not tuned
candidate.unchanged: P16 partition, every unit's parameters (worklog-32 C2 P16 state.pt), training contract, capacity, data
candidate.ownership: parameter ownership unchanged (Theta_i = unit i's triplane+MLP; no shared trainable or immutable learned state); composition parameters: h and the partition samples (fixed geometry)
candidate.output_influence: unit i influences S_i and B_i = {x not in S_i : nbr(x)=i, w(x)>0}; after updating unit i only outputs on S_i U B_i may change; outputs elsewhere are guaranteed bit-identical (to be verified on REINIT); a valid unit j's band adjacent to a dirty unit i depends on f_i, so invalidating i stales B_i inside S_j (reported, not hidden)
candidate.secondary: the same composition applied to P16w is reported as secondary evidence only
candidate.evaluation: held-out 36 C2 views vs 8x references (primary), dev views (labelled), all 40 vs dataset GT (secondary), C1 stress; REINIT regression = REINIT parameters (unit 12 retrained, worklog 32) composed with P16-PU vs P16-PU
